## Detailed Findings

### 1. Duplication Detection

| ID | Severity | Location | Summary | Recommendation |
|-----|----------|----------|---------|----------------|
| DUP-001 | MEDIUM | spec.md FR-001 vs FR-005 | JWT authentication requirement stated twice ("authenticate using JWT" in FR-001, "validate tokens on every request" in FR-005) | Merge into single requirement: "System MUST authenticate users using JWT tokens (15min expiry) validated on every protected request" |
| DUP-002 | MEDIUM | spec.md FR-024, FR-025, FR-026 | User access control requirements overlap ("only see projects assigned", "only see tasks from assigned projects", "enforce access control") | Consolidate into single requirement: "System MUST enforce access control ensuring users only access assigned projects/tasks (server-side filtering)" |
| DUP-003 | LOW | plan.md vs quickstart.md | Docker memory limits documented in both files (plan.md "Constraints", quickstart.md "VPS Deployment") | Accept duplication - different audiences (planners vs operators) |

**Impact**: Minimal. Redundancy adds clarity in most cases, but consolidation would improve maintainability.

---

### 2. Ambiguity Detection

| ID | Severity | Location | Summary | Recommendation |
|-----|----------|----------|---------|----------------|
| AMB-001 | HIGH | spec.md FR-053 | "real-time or near-real-time dashboard updates" lacks measurable definition | Define threshold: "Dashboard updates MUST reflect changes within 10 seconds (via polling every 5s or WebSocket)" |
| AMB-002 | MEDIUM | spec.md FR-039 | "approaching deadline (configurable threshold, default 50%)" - configuration mechanism undefined | Specify: "Threshold configurable via admin panel or environment variable ALERT_THRESHOLD_PERCENT (default 50)" |
| AMB-003 | MEDIUM | spec.md FR-022 | "users can accept or confirm task end dates" - acceptance workflow unclear | Clarify: Does user acceptance trigger state change? Is it mandatory before task can be worked? Define in US4 acceptance criteria. |
| AMB-004 | MEDIUM | spec.md SEC-003 | "reasonable range 0-24" for time entries - what about multi-day tasks? | Specify: "Time entries log hours per day (0-24h), not cumulative. Multi-day work requires multiple entries." |
| AMB-005 | LOW | spec.md SC-015 | "90% of alerted tasks addressed within 24 hours" - how to measure? | Add tracking: "Success measured by alert creation timestamp vs task status change or deadline extension submission timestamp" |
| AMB-006 | LOW | plan.md "Project Type" | "Web application (full-stack with separated backend API and frontend SPA)" - deployment architecture unclear | Clarify: Separate containers for API + frontend, or single-container serving both? (Answer: separate per tasks.md T008-T009) |

**Impact**: HIGH issue (AMB-001) blocks performance testing. MEDIUM issues create implementation confusion.

---

### 3. Underspecification

| ID | Severity | Location | Summary | Recommendation |
|-----|----------|----------|---------|----------------|
| UND-001 | HIGH | spec.md FR-042 | "email alerts" feature specified but no email configuration in plan.md or tasks.md | Add task in Phase 11 (Alerts): "T073a: Configure SMTP email service (nodemailer, SendGrid, or AWS SES) with environment variables (SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS)" |
| UND-002 | HIGH | spec.md US9 + FR-038-043 | Alert system requires background job (cron) but no scheduler task exists | Add task after T020: "T020a: Configure node-cron scheduler service for periodic jobs (alert generation every 15min, cleanup jobs)" |
| UND-003 | MEDIUM | spec.md FR-061 | "audit trail of status changes and assignments" specified but audit_logs table schema not detailed in data-model.md | Verify data-model.md includes audit_logs columns: id, user_id, action (enum), resource_type, resource_id, old_value (JSON), new_value (JSON), ip_address, timestamp |
| UND-004 | MEDIUM | tasks.md T010 | "Execute database/init.sql" assumes file exists but not listed in project structure | Add task T009a: "Create database/init.sql with all table definitions from data-model.md (use SQL DDL statements)" |
| UND-005 | MEDIUM | spec.md US8 | Deadline extension workflow lacks notification to requestor when approved/denied | Add acceptance criterion to US8: "User receives in-app notification + email within 5 minutes of master user decision (FR-037)" |
| UND-006 | MEDIUM | spec.md SEC-004 | "tokens stored in HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies" but cookie configuration not in tasks.md | Add detail to T024: "Set cookie options: httpOnly=true, secure=true (production), sameSite='strict', maxAge=15min (access) / 7d (refresh)" |

**Impact**: HIGH issues (UND-001, UND-002) block entire features (email alerts, scheduled jobs). MEDIUM issues cause implementation delays.

### 6. Inconsistency

| ID | Severity | Location | Summary | Recommendation |
|-----|----------|----------|---------|----------------|
| INC-001 | HIGH | spec.md FR-016 vs plan.md task status enum | FR-016 lists 4 statuses ("Not Started, Iniciada, En Progreso, Completada") but plan.md project structure doesn't specify status enum values - risk of mismatch | Add to T035 task: "Create TaskStatus enum with EXACT values: 'not_started', 'iniciada', 'en_progreso', 'completada' (match database ENUM)" |
| INC-002 | MEDIUM | spec.md FR-015 vs data-model.md Task entity | FR-015 says tasks have "assigned user(s)" (plural) but data-model.md likely uses task_assignments junction table (need to verify) | Confirm task_assignments table supports many-to-many (task can have multiple users, user can have multiple tasks). This is correct design. |

**Impact**: HIGH issue (INC-001) will cause frontend-backend status mismatches if not aligned.

## Recommendations

### Immediate Actions (Before Implementation Starts)

1. **[HIGH] Add Email Service Configuration** (UND-001)
   - Create task T073a: Configure SMTP/email service for alert delivery
   - Update plan.md to document email provider choice (SendGrid, AWS SES, or self-hosted SMTP)

2. **[HIGH] Add Background Job Scheduler** (UND-002)
   - Create task T020a: Set up node-cron for alert generation job (every 15 minutes)
   - Document scheduler configuration in plan.md

3. **[HIGH] Clarify Real-Time Dashboard Updates** (AMB-001)
   - Define "real-time" as polling every 5 seconds or WebSocket (choose one)
   - Update FR-053 with measurable threshold (<10 seconds update latency)

4. **[HIGH] Define Task Status Enum Values** (INC-001)
   - Add to T035: Create TaskStatus enum with EXACT values matching database ENUM
   - Cross-reference with data-model.md to ensure alignment

5. **[HIGH] Add Monitoring Tasks** (GAP-001)
   - Create task T090: Basic monitoring setup (Docker stats, slow query log, health polling)
   - Required to measure SC-023 to SC-025 (system reliability)

### Medium Priority (Address During Implementation)

6. **[MEDIUM] Consolidate Access Control Requirements** (DUP-002)
   - Merge FR-024, FR-025, FR-026 into single comprehensive requirement
   - Update requirement coverage mapping

7. **[MEDIUM] Clarify Task End Date Acceptance Workflow** (AMB-003)
   - Define FR-022 workflow: Is acceptance mandatory? Does it change task state?
   - Add acceptance criteria to US4 or remove if not in scope

8. **[MEDIUM] Add Infrastructure Alerting** (CON-001)
   - Create task T073b: Configure Docker health check alerts (>90% memory usage)
   - Required for Constitution Principle VII compliance

9. **[MEDIUM] Verify Audit Log Implementation** (UND-003)
   - Confirm data-model.md includes detailed audit_logs table schema
   - Add audit logging calls in T031, T034, T023 (all mutation services)

10. **[MEDIUM] Add Database Init SQL Task** (UND-004)
    - Create task T009a: Generate database/init.sql from data-model.md
    - Prevents T010 failure ("file not found")

### Low Priority (Optional Improvements)
